rules.name: sam/no-unvalidated-request-json
rules.evidenceIncident: Typed Hono request JSON masks unvalidated request bodies at runtime.
falsePositiveSamples: Untyped c.req.json() calls are intentionally excluded for this syntax rule.
Route handlers already using jsonValidator(schema) are handled by integration wiring, not this isolated syntax matcher.

expiringExemptions.reason: Advisory rollout while the deterministic ratchet establishes current baseline ownership.

rules.name: sam/no-unsafe-json-parse-assertion
rules.evidenceIncident: Type assertions over JSON.parse were repeatedly mistaken for runtime validation.
falsePositiveSamples: JSON.parse(raw) as unknown is allowed as the neutral parse boundary.
Non-JSON.parse assertions are excluded even when their target type is structural.

expiringExemptions.reason: Kept advisory until discriminating validation-oriented matchers and baselines are integrated.

rules.name: sam/no-local-record-guard
rules.evidenceIncident: Local record/object guards drift from established runtime-validation helpers.
falsePositiveSamples: Guards with different names are excluded.
Guards with extra semantic checks are excluded because automatic replacement is unsafe.

expiringExemptions.reason: Existing call sites need semantics review before shared-helper migration.
